segments.he: אִם מִתְּחִלָּה נָשְׂאָה כּוּ׳. אָמַר רַב הוּנָא: אַיְלוֹנִית — אִשָּׁה וְאֵינָהּ אִשָּׁה, אַלְמָנָה — אִשָּׁה גְּמוּרָה.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches that «if, from the start, he married» her with the understanding that she is an ailonit, she is entitled to payment of her marriage contract. «Rav Huna said: An ailonit» is «a wife and she is not a wife,» while «a widow» who is married to a High Priest is «entirely a wife.»
